treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Armenia and Romania for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1996, as modified by the MLI)
eif_quote: [RO list] Armenia (Text sintetizat) | 121/09.07.1997 | 156/1997 | 01.01.1998 || [AM MLI position] ...Income and on Capital Romania Original 25-03-1996 25-08-1997
source_title: Synthesised text of the MLI and the AM-RO Convention (MLISynthesizedTextRomania.docx, Armenian MoF)

rates.quote: 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends, [MLI Art. 8(1):] [Subparagraph a paragraph 2 of Article 10 of the Convention] shall apply only if the ownership conditions described in those provisions are met throughout a 365 day period that includes the day of the payment of the dividends
10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit

notes: Royalties are in Article 13 of this treaty; Article 12 (Commission) caps tax on commissions paid to brokers/general commission agents at 15% (not modelled). 365-day holding for the 5% dividend tier added by MLI Art. 8(1), effective for WHT from 2025-01-01 (synthesised text: for both Romania and Armenia WHT 'on or after 1 January 2025'). Interest Art. 11(3): exempt if derived and beneficially owned by the Government/local authority/administrative-territorial unit or government agency/bank/institution, or if debt-claims are warranted, insured or financed by a wholly government-owned financial institution. Art. 31: WHT on income derived on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (1997-08-25 -> 1998-01-01).
